paragraphs.en: Claude Duet asks you before sensitive operations like sending messages or paying.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Duet 会在执行发送消息或付款等敏感操作之前先询问你。

paragraphs.en: Approvals, logins, and safety checks run in your own cloud computer, so sensitive details stay private.
paragraphs.zh: 审批、登录和安全检查都在您自己的云端电脑中运行，因此敏感信息得以保密。

paragraphs.en: You can see what Claude Duet has done and is doing for you, and steer it.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以看到 Claude Duet 已经为你完成以及正在为你做的事情，并对其进行引导。

paragraphs.en: Claude Duet is a helpful, proactive agent you hand off work to through messages. Tell it what you need and it works on its own computer in the cloud, using apps you connect. It messages you when it is done or needs a decision from you. While it’s always on, it uses good judgment when it reaches out and knows what can wait.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Duet 是一个乐于助人、主动积极的智能体，你可以通过消息把工作交给它。 告诉它你需要什么，它就会在云端的自己的电脑上独立工作，并使用你连接的应用。 当它完成工作或需要你做决定时，它会给你发消息。 虽然它始终在线，但它在主动联系你时会做出恰当的判断，知道哪些事情可以等一等。

paragraphs.en: Message Claude Duet in the app like a teammate you trust, through text or voice with no prompts or setup. Your history is in one thread. It remembers what you said before, and returns finished work like a doc, sheet, or deck for your review.
paragraphs.zh: 像信任的队友一样，在应用中通过文字或语音与 Claude Duet 对话，无需提示词或任何设置。 你的历史记录保存在同一个对话线程中。 它记得你之前说过的话，并将完成的工作（如文档、表格或幻灯片）交付给你审阅。

paragraphs.en: Claude Duet uses your Claude account, including memory, skills, and connectors. The Claude app waits for you to open a chat, and you work on something alongside Claude. Claude Duet comes to you. It tells you what needs your attention each morning, takes tasks you hand it by message, and reaches out when one is done or needs your approval.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Duet 使用你的 Claude 账户，包括记忆、技能和连接器。 Claude 应用等待你开启对话，而你在 Claude 旁边处理自己的事务。 Claude Duet 主动来到你身边。 它每天早上告诉你哪些事情需要你关注，接受你通过消息交给它的任务，并在任务完成或需要你批准时主动联系你。

paragraphs.en: Claude Duet can send a morning brief, flag what needs you in your inbox and calendar, and draft replies for you to approve. It also takes on some of the work of running a business, like finding unpaid invoices and drafting the reminders, preparing payroll for you to review, and getting contracts ready to send. It can put together a brief, deck, or dashboard too.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Duet 可以发送晨间简报，标记收件箱和日历中需要你处理的事项，并起草回复供你批准。 它还能承担部分经营业务的工作，比如查找未付款的发票并起草催款提醒、准备工资单供你审核，以及把合同准备好以便发送。 它还可以制作简报、演示文稿或仪表盘。
